rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a situation or the facts of what happened.

example.english: The case is a bit complicated right now.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 cing4 fong3 jau5 di1 fuk1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this for an individual case studied or dealt with, especially in medical, social-service, or academic contexts.

example.english: This case needs to be referred to a social worker for follow-up.
example.traditional: 呢個個案要轉介畀社工跟進。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 go3 on3 jiu3 zyun2 gaai3 bei2 se5 gung1 gan1 zeon3

rows.note: Use 喼 for an ordinary suitcase rather than a general box or equipment container.

example.english: I haven’t packed my case yet.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gep1 zung6 mei6 zap1 hou2

rows.note: Use this for a defined police, professional, or legal matter, including a lawsuit or prosecution.

example.english: This case is still being investigated.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 on3 gin6 zung6 diu6 caa4 gan2
